description: This is a Perl script used for managing or analyzing error symbols and documentation references within the cURL project, specifically related to libcurl errors and version symbols. It reads error symbol definitions from documentation and symbol-version files to identify discrepancies.

methods.name: getdocserrors
methods.description: Reads libcurl-errors.3 file to extract documented error symbols and stores them in the %docs hash.

methods.name: getincludeerrors
methods.description: Reads symbols-in-versions file to extract error symbols with their version info and stores them in the %error hash.
